embed_sentences: embed sentences from a text file into vector embeddings using a LASER or HuggingFace encoder
load_model: load a LASER SentenceEncoder or HuggingFace encoder model from a given path with optional SPM or BPE config
encode_file: encode sentences from an input file to binary embeddings written to an output file with buffering
embed_load: load existing binary embedding vectors from a file into a numpy array with specified dimension
embed_mmap: memory map existing binary embedding vectors from a file for efficient disk-backed access
